title: Thavamai Thavamirunthu
desc: Saradha and Muthaiah, a village-based couple, face financial difficulties while raising their two sons, Ramanathan and Ramalingam. Problems escalate when Ramalingam gets his girlfriend pregnant.

title: Bheeshmar
desc: Framed and jailed, honest cop Bheeshmar considers revenge after his wife dies, but ultimately decides to start anew with his child instead of seeking payback.

title: Thalaimagan
desc: Dheeran, an aggressive journalist, is dedicated to his work and faces many challenges while trying to expose a bottled water company that is causing harm to people.

title: Mariyaan
desc: Mariyaan Joseph, a fisherman, is forced to take up employment in Sudan after his girlfriend faces financial issues. However, he finds himself in danger after crossing paths with some extremists.

title: Bhooloham
desc: Boologam and Arumugam are two famous boxers whose families are arch-rivals. Taking this into consideration, Deepak, a businessman, hatches a plan to use their rivalry to his advantage.
